suicidal: I don’t want to live anymore.
What’s the point of going on?
I’m tired of fighting every day.
I wish I could just disappear forever.
Nobody would even notice if I was gone.
hopeless: There’s no way out of this mess.
I feel like I’ve failed at everything.
Everything I try ends in disappointment.
I don’t see a future for myself anymore.
Hope is a joke. Nothing ever changes.
self_harm: Hurting myself is the only thing that helps.
I feel better when I see the pain on the outside.
Cutting is the only way I feel something.
I know it's bad, but I can’t stop.
The pain distracts me from my thoughts.
depression: I’m exhausted all the time, even after sleeping.
I fake a smile so no one asks questions.
Everything feels numb. Like I’m just existing.
I cry alone at night. Nobody knows.
I feel like I’m drowning in my own thoughts.
anxiety: My chest feels tight all the time.
I keep overthinking everything I say.
Even small things make me panic now.
I get nervous just talking to people.
I feel like I can’t breathe when things go wrong.
positive: I finally feel like I’m making progress.
Today was actually a good day.
I feel proud of myself for getting help.
I’m learning to trust myself again.
I’m starting to believe things can get better.
